prompt: Recommend a queue policy for the synthetic service using only the supplied local corpus and cite every factual claim.

inputs.question: Which delivery and retry policy satisfies the documented constraints?

constraints: Use only the supplied local corpus
Use this exact non-factual summary sentence: Queue-policy research complete; see the seven cited source facts and one cited recommendation below.

Return exactly eight generated_result.observations and no extras. The first seven cover each documented fact once: at-least-once delivery; idempotency by request identifier; per-customer-account ordering; three retries with exponential backoff; dead-letter handling with a recorded cause before replay; exclusion of access tokens and raw personal identifiers from payloads; and audit request identifiers retained for thirty days

The eighth observation must be labeled recommendation-inference, recommend at-least-once delivery with per-account ordering, idempotent request handling, the documented retry and dead-letter policy, payload minimization, and thirty-day audit identifier retention, and cite the supporting sections from all three supplied notes. Do not repeat this recommendation or any factual policy claim in generated_result.summary
